input.command:
cd "C:/Users/shrey/desktop/Elemental_harness" && git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Point compaction checkpoints to a stored transcript and re-attach read files

With a spill store mounted, the condensed span is saved as a plain-text
transcript and the checkpoint names it. With a filesystem mounted, up to
5 recently read files are re-read from disk and attached (5,000 tokens
each, 50,000 total). Recovery context is priced within the budget left
after the summary, so a checkpoint always shrinks what it replaces.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log -1 --oneline && git status --short | head -3; git push -q -u origin compaction-phase3 2>&1 | grep -v "^remote:" | tail -2; git tag -a compaction-v3 -m "Phase 3: stored transcript and re-attached files after compaction" && git push -q origin refs/tags/compaction-v3 2>&1 | tail -1; git ls-remote origin refs/tags/compaction-v3 refs/heads/compaction-phase3
